context_title:
On February 9, I received a criminal order + indictment from the Veszprém District Court (case number: 11.Bpk.699/2025/7.) (B.2921/2024/12.) for disorderly conduct, in which I was fined 100 daily installments × 2000 Ft = 200,000 Ft without a trial, payable in 10 monthly installments. The essence of the case: on July 31, 2024, in Balatonfűzfő, at the Szitakötő restaurant, I allegedly "threw with great force" an ashtray into the restaurant. I DISPUTE THE FACTS: I did not throw the ashtray anywhere, but deliberately let it go and it fell to the ground - I already said this during the police interrogation (I have an audio recording of it). The restaurant manager (Éva Piszku) provoked us FIRST with vulgar, offensive language (she mentioned my friend's dead mother and insulted me as well), and only THEN did the argument begin. The witnesses listed in the indictment (Éva Piszku, Alex Ádám Khirer, Dorottya Deák, Béla Piszku) were employees/relatives of the restaurant = conflict of interest. I was with two friends (whom I will not name here) who were NOT questioned as witnesses, even though they can corroborate my version of events. I MUST request a hearing within the 8-day deadline (by February 17), which I intend to do. IN ADDITION: (1) I request that all documents be sent electronically, ESPECIALLY the evidence referred to under the heading "data collection documents (traffic violation, VÉDA images)"; (2) I have DÁP access, so I also request official electronic delivery; (3) I would like to be treated as an OFFENDED PARTY, because I was provoked/offended first, and there were also racist/discriminatory statements; (4) I would like to assert a civil law claim against everyone (false accusation, false testimony, defamation); (5) I would like to file a criminal complaint for false accusation/false testimony. I would like an email/submission that is 100% legally flawless, contains all relevant legislation/constitutional rights, but is calm, unassailable, and "international" (as if written by Cardi B's lawyer). 
Email I received: INFORMATION FOR RECIPIENTS OF SIMPLIFIED ELECTRONIC DELIVERY Please confirm receipt of the shipment! Dear Recipient The Veszprém District Court hereby informs you that, pursuant to Section 132(6) of Act XC of 2017 on Criminal Procedure (Be.), I am delivering the attached document to you by simplified electronic means to the email address you provided. The message received from the court by e-mail is considered official. You can verify the authenticity of the sender of the message at the court's customer service center by calling 06-88/590-220 or 06-70/684-7031 (on working days from 7:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.). . After opening the attachment, you must confirm receipt of the email on the day of receipt at the following address: email: by clicking on the "Reply" tab, and your statement must include the following: "I have received the document specified by the Veszprém District Court under case number ." After confirmation, the document sent by email shall be deemed to have been delivered on the date of confirmation (Section 132(7) of the Code of Civil Procedure). Your reply email is only for confirmation of delivery. The automatic read receipt set up for your email account does not constitute a statement. If delivery fails due to lack of confirmation, the court will deliver the document in paper form by post. Please note that if you grant access to your electronic mailbox or to documents sent by the court to another person, you are responsible for this. 
VÁ D I R A T A in the criminal case against Sándor Kollár for disorderly conduct. SÁNDOR KOLLÁR (born on April 16, 2003, in Kiskunfélegyháza, mother's name: Katalin Szabó, Hungarian citizen, personal identification number: 283039SE, address: 6100 Kiskunfélegyháza, Szőlő u. 10. door number 3, no criminal record) was charged with assaulting the restaurant manager, Éva Piszku, using offensive language. He then picked up an ashtray from a table on the terrace and deliberately threw it with great force into the restaurant, where several people were present. The ashtray hit the plastic part of the window and broke. The suspect, Sándor Kollár, behaved in a provocatively anti-social and violent manner, which was likely to cause outrage or alarm in others. Evidence: - Criminal complaint (7.1.) - Data collection documents (traffic violation, VÉDA images) (8.2.1., 8.1.5.) - Éva Piszku - minutes of witness examination, continued interrogation (8.3.1., 8.3.2.) - presentation for identification from photographs (8.3.3.) - Khirer Alex Ádám - minutes of witness examination (8.3.4.) - photo identification (8.3.5.) - Deák Dorottya - minutes of witness examination (8.3.6.) - Piszku Béla - minutes of witness examination (8.3.8.) - Kollár Sádnor - minutes of suspect examination
 There is no right of appeal against the penalty order, but the prosecutor and the defendant may request a hearing within eight (8) days of delivery. The consequences of missing the deadline shall not apply if the submission was sent by registered mail to the address of the court hearing the case no later than the last day of the deadline. A motion for a hearing shall have the effect of postponing the enforcement of the penalty or measure imposed in the criminal order or the fulfillment of the provisions thereof. The petitioner may withdraw the motion for a hearing until the start of the preparatory hearing. A motion for a hearing filed by another person on behalf of the defendant may only be withdrawn by the petitioner with the consent of the defendant; this provision does not apply to motions filed by the prosecutor. The person filing the motion for a hearing is required to be present at the preparatory hearing. If they do not appear at the preparatory hearing, they shall be deemed to have withdrawn their motion. Reasoning: [1] In its indictment No. B.2921/ 2024/12 dated June 16, 2025, the Veszprém District Prosecutor's Office charged the defendant with one count of disorderly conduct in violation of Section 339(1) of the Criminal Code and requested that the court decide the case without a hearing. - 2 - [2] The court found the following in the case: [3] The defendant, Sándor Kollár, is a Hungarian citizen, Hungarian native speaker, educational background: secondary school, marital status: single, no minor children, occupation: IT specialist, place of work: self-employed, monthly net income: HUF 800,000, assets: none. He has no previous convictions. [4] The defendant committed the following crime: [5] On July 31, 2024, at around 5:40 p.m., in Balatonfűzfő, at the Szitakötő restaurant operating on Tobruki Beach on Fáy András Street, the defendant picked a fight with the restaurant manager, Éva Piszku, whom he addressed with offensive language. He then took a glass ashtray from a table on the terrace and deliberately threw it with great force into the restaurant, where several people were present. The ashtray hit the plastic part of the window and shattered. [6] The suspect's provocative, anti-social, violent behavior was likely to cause outrage or alarm in others. [7] By his above behavior, the defendant committed the misdemeanor of disorderly conduct under Section 339(1) of the Criminal Code. [8] The court found that the conditions necessary for the imposition of a criminal penalty, as set out in Sections 740(1) and 741(1) of the Criminal Procedure Code, were met and therefore decided the case without a trial. [9] Additional legislation applied by the court: [10] Act C of 2012 on the Criminal Code (Btk.): Section 2, Section 33(4), Section 50(1), (3) and (4). (11) [11] Act XC of 2017 on Criminal Procedure (CPC): Section 740(1), Section 740(2)(a), Section 741(1), (3), (4), Sections 742 and 744. Veszprém, June 25, 2025. Dr. Anita Litkei-Szabó, Judge




Ezt mindent ebben az emailben akarom nekik tudatni
egyébként az éttermi kamera felvételek (ha vannak es nem csak kamu) is engem igazolnak egyértelműen én voltam az áldozat
tehát ezt mind akarom 

Well, I have to indicate if I want a hearing. I called the woman at the court, and she said that when I reply that I have received/accepted this email, I should indicate that I want a hearing — and of course I want a hearing.

Then I'll pay, they believed me.
I want to sue them all, but in such a way that even their grandchildren will pay me.

Well, of course, the woman got involved with us completely at random, took everything away from us, and now she's talking shit about my dead mother-in-law, calling her a whore and stuff like that.
Then they pretended to be all innocent, like, oh, poor things, they've been through trauma.
Meanwhile, I grabbed an ash tray and dropped it, but it didn't break or anything.

Plus, I don't even understand what the court decided or how they imagined it.
Basically, I was there: they questioned all the shitty kids as witnesses (who worked for the girl, of course, so they weren't going to speak against their boss). Then I wasn't alone, and the woman didn't just pick on me. So the point is, make the email draft so that you look up all the laws, rights, etc., and make the email so that even the most professional judge/lawyer/prosecutor on Earth, no one, can find fault with it.

Do much more research, make it so that even the international news will report on how great I am. I want something like Cardi B in court: the whole world knows how savage I am, and I won't let them drag me down because they know I'm loaded with money.

But no: don't name my witnesses.
I demand that my status be that of a victim, not a defendant.
And I'll sue them all; I'll file a motion for that too.
We should also deal with the fact that from January onwards, they are REQUIRED to send the documents via DÁP, and that even before the trial, I demand the "Documents of data collection activities" (expiry date, VÉDA images) (8.2.1., 8.1.5.) etc.

And look up all the laws and legal terms, leave these capital letters in, and write everything so that you find a way to be 100% legally correct.
And I'm offended because they picked on me, not me on them — well, why would I care, xd.
And include racism too, so we can sue for that as well. I want to look at all the Hungarian laws and rights in a very brutal, cunning way, but I want to defend myself with absolute certainty so that I come out of this whole thing well and everyone else just sees what happens in a situation like this. And I want as much as possible in this reply email because that's what I need. I want everything in the email to shock them and leave them speechless when they read it.

I want to let them know all of this in this email.
By the way, the restaurant's CCTV footage (if it exists and isn't fake) clearly proves that I was the victim.
So I want all of this 
and I'm definitely not going to travel to Veszprém from Szeged, either they come down here or I'll be present at the hearing online at most, because I've had enough of the shit I've been through, and they're even writing in the email how much I earn, as if I were a child, so I've had enough now, if the world treats me like a money bag, then that's what I'll be from now on, and everything will be the way I want it to be, because I am rich and now I'm going to give myself what I deserve.

A bírósági iratokban található tényállás vitatására, a tárgyalás iránti kérelem benyújtására, valamint az elektronikus kapcsolattartásra és további beadványokra vonatkozóan átfogó dokumentációra van szükséged. Alaposan elemeztem a csatolt dokumentumokat és a releváns jogszabályokat. Az alábbiakban egy professzionális, jogi szempontból megállapított e-mail tervezetet nyújtok be, amely tartalmazza az összes általad kért elemet.

***

## **E-MAIL TERVEZET A VESZPRÉMI JÁRÁSBÍRÓSÁGHOZ**

**Tárgy:** A Veszprémi Járásbíróság 11.Bpk.699/2025/7. számú büntetővégzésének kézhezvételi visszaigazolása + TÁRGYALÁS TARTÁSÁRA IRÁNYULÓ INDÍTVÁNY és további beadványok

**Tisztelt Veszprémi Járásbíróság!**

**Alulírott KOLLÁR SÁNDOR** (szül.: 2003. április 16., anyja neve: Szabó Katalin, lakcím: 6100 Kiskunfélegyháza, Szőlő u. 10. 3. ajtó, e-mail: kollarsandor5@gmail.com) az alábbiakban **visszaigazolom**, hogy a Veszprém Járásbíróság **11.Bpk.699/2025/7. számú büntetővégzését és a B.2921/2024/12. számú vádiratot 2026. február 9. napján elektronikus úton megkaptam**.[1][2][3]

A jelen levélben a következő eljárási cselekményeket és kérelmeket terjesztem elő:

***

### **I. TÁRGYALÁS TARTÁSÁRA IRÁNYULÓ INDÍTVÁNY**

A **Be. 742. § (2) bekezdése** alapján, a kézbesítéstől számított 8 napos határidő figyelembevételével **tárgyalás tartását indítványozom**.[4]

**A büntetővégzésben megállapított tényállást teljes terjedelmében VITATOM**, mivel az a valóságnak nem felel meg, súlyosan sértő és a bizonyítási teher helytelen alkalmazásán alapul.

***

### **II. A TÉNYÁLLÁS VITATÁSA – A VALÓS ESEMÉNYSOR**

#### **A) A büntetővégzésben és vádiratban foglalt tényállás hibái**

A 2024. július 31-én Balatonfűzfőn, a Szitakötő étteremben történt eseményekkel kapcsolatban a következő pontosításokat és vitatásokat nyújtom be:[2][3]

1. **Az esemény kiváltója:** NEM ÉN provokáltam az étterem üzletvezetőjét, Piszku Évát, hanem ő kezdeményezte a konfliktust velünk szemben. Piszku Éva minden ok nélkül belekötött belénk, majd **súlyosan sértő, vulgáris, obszcén kifejezéseket használt**, amelyek közül több **diszkriminatív és rasszista** jellegű volt.[3][2]

2. **Személyes sértések, gyalázások:** Piszku Éva **barátom elhunyt édesanyjára vonatkozóan gyalázkodó, sértő kifejezéseket használt** (nevezetesen: „kurva" kifejezést és egyéb trágár megnevezéseket), ami súlyos lelki sérelmet és megbotránkozást okozott számunkra. Ez a magatartás **a Btk. 226. § (1) bekezdése szerinti rágalmazás vétségét**, továbbá **a Btk. 227. § szerinti becsületsértés vétségét valósítja meg**.[5][6]

3. **A hamutartó „eldobásának" hamis állítása:** A vádiratban és a büntetővégzésben foglalt állítás, miszerint „szándékosan, nagy erővel bedobtam" a hamutartót, **VALÓTLAN**. Az általam a **rendőrségi kihallgatáson tett vallomás** (amelyről **hangfelvételem van**) egyértelműen bizonyítja: **a hamutartót NEM DOBTAM el, hanem SZÁNDÉKOSAN ELEJTETTEM** – azaz a kezemből kiengedtem, és az a földre esett. **A hamutartó NEM tört össze, az ablakhoz NEM csapódott**.[2][3]

4. **Erőszakos magatartás hiánya:** A vádiratban szereplő „kihívóan közösségellenes, erőszakos magatartás" **nem valósult meg**. Nem tanúsítottam olyan magatartást, amely alkalmas lett volna megbotránkozás vagy riadalom keltésére.[3][5][2]

#### **B) Bizonyítékok a védelmemre**

1. **Saját vallomásom és hangfelvé A 2024. július 31-i rendőrségi kihallgatásom során már **egyértelműen leírtam a valós eseményeket**, és ezen kihallgatásról **hangfelvétellel is rendelkezem**, amely igazolja, hogy a vád alaptalan.

2. **Tanúk kihallgatásának mellőzése:** A velem együtt jelenlévő két barátom **nem került meghallgatásra**, holott ők **közvetlen tanúi voltak az eseményeknek**, és vallomásuk **bizonyítaná az én verziómat** és **cáfolná Piszku Éva és alkalmazottai hamis állításait**.

3. **Az éttermi térfigyelő kamerák felvételei (ha léteznek):** A vádiratban hivatkozott „VÉDA képek" és „adatszerző tevékenység iratai" (8.2.1., 8.1.5.) valószínűsíthetően tartalmazzák a helyszíni felvételeket, amelyek **egyértelműen bizonyítják, hogy ÉN voltam a provokáció ÁLDOZATA**.[2]

***

### **III. A BIZONYÍTÁSI ESZKÖZÖK SÚLYOS HIÁNYOSSÁGAI ÉS A TANÚK ELFOGULTSÁGÁNAK KÉRDÉSE**

#### **A) A Be. 52. § és 53. § szerinti tanúi elfogultság és összeférhetetlenség**

A vádiratban felsorolt tanúk (Piszku Éva, Khirer Alex Ádám, Deák Dorottya, Piszku Béla) **valamennyien az étterem alkalmazottjai vagy tulajdonos rokonai**, ezért **nyilvánvaló összeférhetetlenségi és elfogultsági okok állnak fenn velük szemben**.[7][8][2]
